scenarios.name: postcombat-main-adds-red-for-life-opponents-lost
scenarios.why: At the beginning of your postcombat main phase add {R} for each 1 life your opponents have lost this turn: with an opponent having lost 3 life this turn, three red mana is added.

scenarios.name: no-life-lost-means-no-red
scenarios.why: With no life lost by opponents this turn the postcombat-main trigger adds nothing.

scenarios.name: afflict-three-when-neheb-becomes-blocked
scenarios.why: Afflict 3: whenever this creature becomes blocked, the defending player loses 3 life. A blocked Neheb therefore drops the defender from 20 to 17.
